name: mail-warmer
description: mailWarmer Chrome extension, its website and store kit.

scripts.build: node scripts/preflight.mjs && mkdir -p release && rm -f release/mailwarmer-$npm_package_version.zip && cd extension && zip -qrX ../release/mailwarmer-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '.*' && echo "release/mailwarmer-$npm_package_version.zip"
